title: Moduli of toric principal bundles
summary: Let $G$ be a reductive algebraic group. A toric principal $G$-bundle is a principal $G$-bundle over a toric variety together with a torus action commuting with the $G$-action. Extending the Klyachko classification of toric vector bundles, Kaveh-Manon classify toric principal bundles by piecewise linear maps to the (extended) Tits building of $G$. In this paper, we use this classification to construct a moduli space of (framed) toric principal bundles with given total equivariant characteristic class, as a locally closed subvariety of a product of partial flag varieties.
